opportunities.title: The Open Fund for Music Creators
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK-based music creators (songwriters, composers, artists, bands, producers or performers who write their own music) at any career stage and of all genres and backgrounds
opportunities.summary: Supports the development of outstanding music creators of all genres and backgrounds at different stages of their career with grants of up to £5,000, covering creation, performance and promotion of outstanding new music, realising potential, and reaching audiences.

opportunities.title: PPL Momentum Music Fund
opportunities.summary: Offers grants of £5k-£15k for UK based artists/bands to break through to the next level of their careers. Eligible activities include recording, touring and marketing. Run by PRS Foundation in partnership with PPL, Creative Wales and Arts Council of Northern Ireland.

opportunities.title: PPL Momentum Accelerator Liverpool
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Songwriters, artists, bands and performers who write their own music based in Liverpool City Region, as well as future industry professionals based in Liverpool City Region
opportunities.summary: A targeted scheme to support the development of outstanding artists and bands writing their own music, and future industry professionals, outside London who face additional barriers based on their location. Provides financial support of up to £5k to help artists reach or get beyond early career tipping points.

opportunities.title: PPL Momentum Accelerator Tees Valley
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Songwriters, artists, bands and performers who write their own music based in Tees Valley, as well as future industry professionals based in Tees Valley
opportunities.summary: A targeted scheme to support the development of outstanding artists and bands writing their own music, and future industry professionals, outside London who face additional barriers based on their location. Provides financial support of up to £5k to help artists reach or get beyond early career tipping points.

opportunities.title: Women Make Music
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Women, trans and non binary songwriters, composers, artists, bands and performers who are writing their own music
opportunities.summary: Supports the development of outstanding women, trans and non binary songwriters and composers of all genres and backgrounds at different stages of their career. There will be one bumper deadline in the second half of 2026 while the programme is being developed.

opportunities.title: International Showcase Fund (ISF)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK-based artists, bands, songwriters and producers who have been formally invited to perform or create new music at international industry-facing showcasing festivals, songwriting camps or conferences
opportunities.summary: Offers grants of up to £5,500 for international export opportunities for UK-based artists, bands, songwriters and producers invited to perform or create new music at international industry-facing showcasing festivals, song writing camps or conferences.

opportunities.title: Composers' Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Composers with a strong track record who are already making a significant cultural contribution in the UK and have potential for greater impact in the UK and overseas
opportunities.summary: An opportunity for composers with a strong track record, giving direct access to funding at pivotal stages in their career. Supports up to 15 composers per year. Previous projects include recordings, promotion and performance of existing works, international co-commissions, residencies, sabbaticals and childcare costs.

opportunities.title: The Hitmaker Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Songwriters and producers working in popular music genres
opportunities.summary: Offers an opportunity for songwriters and producers working in popular music genres to further develop their careers and writing/production with grants of between £5,000-£10,000. Delivered by PRS Foundation.

opportunities.title: Early Career Promoter Fund
opportunities.summary: Recognises the vital role independent promoters play in supporting the talent pipeline across England, offering grant funding and capacity building support. Supports booking/programming/promotion of gigs, concerts, club nights, showcases and tours, plus capacity building. Managed by PRS Foundation, supported by Arts Council England and DCMS.

opportunities.title: Resonate
opportunities.summary: A fund and resource which encourages professional orchestras to programme into their repertoire the best pieces of British music from the past 25 years. Offers financial support with grants of up to £10K to orchestras who commit to exploring contemporary UK repertoire as part of a season/tour and longer term audience development programme.
